description: PATCH /v1/paymaster/limits - sets this merchant's overrides. An omitted field is left untouched. Effective = min(platform, merchant), so a merchant value can never raise the effective limit above the platform's - but it can still raise or lower this merchant's own override. null clears the override entirely, which loosens the effective limit back to the platform default - and for perTxCapUsdMicros to no cap at all, because the platform never sets one. perTxCapUsdMicros applies to billed sponsored ops only (a live key on a billed chain); perUserDailyCapUsdMicros bounds sponsored ops only. Setting perTxCapUsdMicros also makes every billed sponsored op depend on a live ETH/USD rate: with a cap set and no rate available the op is refused with paymaster_merchant_tx_cap_unpriceable (status denied_merchant_limit); with no cap that check never runs. Both directions change live sponsorship - confirm with user.

anyOf.description: Cap on a single operation's cost (not per sender), USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

perTxCapUsdMicros.description: Cap on a single operation's cost (not per sender), USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

anyOf.description: Per-sender daily cap, USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

perUserDailyCapUsdMicros.description: Per-sender daily cap, USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

perUserRatePerHour.description: Per-sender ops per hour. null clears the override.
